extra._comment: ADR-024 RENAME (was the D-05 working title): name/slug/scheme are 'quiks' and ios.bundleIdentifier/android.package are 'at.quiks.app'. These remain provisional until the first EAS Submit freezes the bundle ID. The 'scheme' value ('quiks') MUST stay in sync with apps/api's auth.instance.ts trustedOrigins entry ('quiks://') and with apps/mobile/lib/auth-client.ts's expoClient scheme — the mobile client sends it as the 'expo-origin' header and better-auth's origin/CSRF check rejects any value not on that allowlist.
extra._devOnlyCleartextComment: DEV-BUILD-ONLY (Pitfall G / D-10 / T-03-14): android.usesCleartextTraffic (via the expo-build-properties plugin) and ios.infoPlist.NSAppTransportSecurity.NSAllowsLocalNetworking exist ONLY to let a local dev build reach the LAN API over plain HTTP (EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL=http://<lan-ip>:8081). NSAllowsLocalNetworking is Apple's narrowly-scoped local-network ATS exception (RFC1918/.local/loopback only) chosen over NSAllowsArbitraryLoads so public-internet ATS enforcement stays intact. This MUST NOT be carried into any release/EAS build profile — no such profile is configured this phase (JSON has no comment syntax, hence this documented _comment field, matching the _comment convention already used above).
